info.title: Wachat API
info.description: Wachat REST API. Authenticate with a workspace API key: send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Generate keys in the dashboard under Developers / API.

tags.name: Message
tags.description: Send a single WhatsApp message — text, media (image / video / document / audio) or a location pin — to one number, then read its delivery status or your message history. A file can be attached directly as a multipart `media` field or referenced by a public URL.

tags.name: Template
tags.description: Create, list and manage your approved WhatsApp templates, and send a template to one number with your own header, body variables and button values. Use this for utility / marketing sends that need a pre-approved template — including one with a PDF / document header (pass the file's public URL as the header, e.g. from the Media endpoint).

tags.name: Media
tags.description: Upload a file once (multipart / form-data, field name `file`, up to 16 MB) and get back a hosted public URL you can reuse across sends — for example a PDF to use as a document-header on a template, or an image on a message.

tags.name: Contact
tags.description: Full create / read / update / delete over your contacts and leads, including search by number, tags and custom attributes.

tags.name: ContactGroup
tags.description: Organise contacts into groups: create groups, list them, and add or remove members — handy for targeting broadcasts and campaigns.

tags.name: Broadcast
tags.description: Send the same message to many contacts at once and track each broadcast's progress and per-recipient delivery.

tags.name: Campaign
tags.description: Create, start, pause and monitor drip / marketing campaigns and their recipients.

tags.name: Scheduled
tags.description: Schedule a WhatsApp send for a future time, list upcoming scheduled messages, and cancel one before it goes out.

tags.name: AutoReply
tags.description: Manage keyword auto-replies — the automatic responses that fire when an inbound message matches a rule.

tags.name: Flow
tags.description: Enroll a contact into an automation flow (chatbot) and manage your flows through the API.

tags.name: Device
tags.description: List the WhatsApp numbers / devices connected to your workspace and check each one's connection status.

tags.name: Webhook
tags.description: Register and manage webhook endpoints so Wachat POSTs real-time events (message received / sent / delivered / read / failed, plus campaign and contact events) to your server. When you set a signing secret each delivery carries an HMAC-SHA256 signature header you can verify.

tags.name: Deal
tags.description: Manage sales-pipeline deals — create, list, update and move deals between stages.

tags.name: Conversation
tags.description: Read your workspace inbox: list chat threads (conversations) and fetch the messages inside a thread.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Read your account details, plan, limits and message-credit usage.

get.description: Returns the account and workspace associated with the bearer token. Use this endpoint when your integration needs to confirm the active workspace, inspect its plan and limits, or read the feature flags available to the API key.

limits.description: Plan limits. A null value means unlimited.

get.description: Returns the current billing-period message usage for the authenticated workspace. Use it to show consumption, remaining allowance, reset timing, and available wallet credits before sending campaigns or high-volume messages.

plan.description:
Plan VALIDITY (subscription expiry) — distinct from the monthly
message cycle above; a year out for yearly plans. null = no expiry.

get.description: Lists keyword auto-reply rules configured for the workspace. Use it to display, audit, or manage the rules that answer matching inbound messages.

post.description: Creates a keyword auto-reply rule that responds when an inbound message matches its configured trigger. Use it for simple automated answers without creating a full flow.

get.description: Deletes an auto-reply rule and prevents it from responding to future matching messages.

put.description: Updates the trigger, response, or status of an auto-reply rule.

delete.description: Deletes an auto-reply rule and prevents it from responding to future matching messages.

post.description: Creates and dispatches a broadcast to contacts or groups using a message or approved template. Use it for one-to-many delivery when you need recipient-level status tracking.

get.description: Lists recent broadcasts for the workspace. Use it to show delivery history, status, and campaign operations to workspace users.
Returns one broadcast with its current status and delivery counts. Use it to monitor a broadcast after dispatch or before deciding whether to stop it.
Returns per-recipient delivery information for a broadcast. Use it to identify pending, delivered, failed, or rejected recipients after a broadcast is created.

message.const: Only scheduled or in-flight broadcasts can be stopped.

post.description: Stops a scheduled or in-progress broadcast when it should no longer deliver. Messages already accepted by the sender may still complete, while recipients that have not been processed are prevented from continuing.

get.description: Returns workspace-level campaign delivery statistics. Use it to compare campaign outcomes and monitor totals across sent, delivered, failed, and pending messages.
Lists campaigns for the workspace. Use it to display campaign history, status, and performance before opening an individual campaign.

post.description: Creates and dispatches a campaign to a defined recipient audience, immediately or on a schedule. Use campaigns for larger sends that need delivery metrics and lifecycle status.

get.description: Returns one campaign with recipient counts, status, and delivery metrics.

delete.description: Deletes a campaign according to its current lifecycle state.

post.description: Stops a scheduled or running campaign. Use this endpoint to halt future processing while preserving the campaign record and its existing delivery history.

get.description: Lists contacts belonging to the authenticated workspace with pagination and optional search. Use it to build recipient pickers, synchronize a CRM, or find the contact ID required by other endpoints.

post.description: Creates a contact in the authenticated workspace. Use it to add a recipient before sending, store profile data and custom attributes, and reuse the contact in groups, broadcasts, or campaigns.

get.description: Deletes one contact from the workspace. Use it when the recipient should no longer be available to contact, group, campaign, or CRM workflows.

put.description: Updates the supplied fields of one contact without replacing unrelated attributes. Use it to keep recipient names, numbers, tags, or custom data synchronized with your application.

delete.description: Deletes one contact from the workspace. Use it when the recipient should no longer be available to contact, group, campaign, or CRM workflows.

get.description: Lists contact groups and their member counts for the workspace.

post.description: Creates a contact group for organizing recipients. Use groups to reuse a target audience across broadcasts and campaigns instead of sending a long recipient list on every request.

delete.description: Deletes a contact group and detaches its membership links. Contacts themselves are not deleted by this operation.

get.description: Lists recent WhatsApp conversations for the workspace. Use it to build an inbox or locate a conversation ID before requesting its messages.

Lists the messages belonging to one conversation, ordered for conversation history and support workflows. Use the conversation ID returned by the conversations endpoint to load a thread into your application.
Lists CRM deals with optional pipeline, stage, and status filters. Use it to build sales views and retrieve opportunities for follow-up automation.

post.description: Creates a CRM deal associated with the workspace. Use it to represent an opportunity and track its pipeline, stage, value, status, and contact relationship.

get.description: Returns one CRM deal with its pipeline and contact information.

put.description: Updates a CRM deal, including its stage and status. Use it to advance an opportunity as conversations and sales activity progress.

delete.description: Deletes a CRM deal from the workspace.

get.description: Lists the WhatsApp devices and provider channels owned by the workspace. Use it to select a sender, inspect connection status, and obtain device IDs for message requests.

message.const: Device created. Scan the QR code to finish pairing.
This API key needs the devices.write scope.
This phone number is already connected to the workspace.
The device could not be created.
The device was not created because pairing could not be started. Please retry.
The device pairing service is not configured.

post.description: Creates a WhatsApp device for the authenticated workspace and starts the pairing process. The response includes the initial device information and QR data when available; scan it with WhatsApp to finish connecting the sender.

message.const: Could not refresh the device QR code.
The device pairing service is not configured.

get.description: Returns or refreshes the QR code for a device that is waiting for WhatsApp pairing. Use the response to render the QR code in your integration and poll the device status until pairing is complete.
Returns one connected device and its current connection state.

message.const: Use a numeric Unofficial API device ID or a cfg_<id> sender ID.

delete.description: Permanently removes a connected device and its associated sender data. Use it when a WhatsApp number should no longer send from this workspace.

get.description: Lists automation flows available to the workspace. Use it to let your application select a flow for contact enrollment and lifecycle automation.
Returns one automation flow and its configuration. Use it to inspect the flow before enrolling contacts or displaying its status in an automation dashboard.

message.const: No contact matches that id or phone in this workspace.

post.description: Enrolls a contact into an automation flow using a contact ID or phone number. Enrollment is idempotent, so retrying the same request does not create duplicate subscriptions.

get.description: Lists the contacts enrolled in an automation flow together with their current subscription state. Use it to monitor who entered a flow and to build operational dashboards.

file.description: Max 16 MB — the WhatsApp document ceiling.

post.description: Uploads a media file and returns a hosted URL that can be reused in message and template requests. Use this endpoint when the file is not already publicly accessible; keep the returned URL available until the message has been processed.

message.const: The selected device does not belong to the workspace associated with this API key.

post.description: Sends one WhatsApp message through a connected workspace device. Use it for text, media, location, and supported interactive message types; the request can select a sender or use the workspace default.

get.description: Lists recent messages for the workspace. Use it for message history, delivery reconciliation, and support views; filter and pagination options are described by the request parameters.
Returns the delivery status and metadata for one message. Use the message ID from the send response to reconcile queued, sent, delivered, read, or failed states.

message.const: An owner API key is required.

get.description: Lists the isolated reseller workspaces owned by the authenticated primary workspace. Use it to display reseller accounts and track the workspaces managed through the reseller API.

warning.const: Store this key now. It is shown only once.

message.const: An owner API key is required.

post.description: Creates an isolated reseller workspace and returns its initial workspace key. Use it when provisioning a new customer environment; the generated key must be stored securely because it is returned only once.

warning.const: Store this key now. It is shown only once.

message.const: This workspace already has an active API key.

post.description: Issues a replacement operational API key for a reseller workspace. Revoke the existing active key first, then store the returned key securely because it is shown only when issued.

delete.description: Revokes the active operational API key for a reseller workspace. Use it immediately when a key is exposed or when access for that reseller must be stopped.

message.const: Template not found in this workspace.

post.description: Schedules a WhatsApp message, template, or flow send for a future time. Use the request timezone and send timestamp to control delivery timing; the response identifies the scheduled job for later tracking or cancellation.

get.description: Lists upcoming and recent scheduled messages for the workspace. Use it to build a schedule view or find the ID needed to inspect or cancel a pending send.
Returns one scheduled message and its current processing state. Use it to confirm the planned content, recipient set, send time, and whether the job has already been processed.

delete.description: Cancels a future scheduled message before it is processed. Use the scheduled message ID returned when the job was created.

get.description: Lists WhatsApp templates available to the workspace. Use it to select approved templates for individual sends, broadcasts, and campaigns.

post.description: Creates a WhatsApp template submission with its body, variables, category, and optional header or buttons. Use it when you need a reusable message that can be submitted for Meta approval.

get.description: Returns the Meta template categories accepted when creating or updating a WhatsApp template. Use this list to validate the category value before submitting a template for approval.

to.description: Recipient phone in international format — digits or +E.164 (e.g. 919812345678). Required.

device_id.description:
Optional sender selector: baileys:<device_id>, waba:<config_id>,
or twilio:<config_id>. Blank uses the workspace default.

header_text.description: Value for a {{1}} in a TEXT header. Only for text-header templates.

header_media_url.description: Public https URL for an IMAGE / VIDEO / DOCUMENT header. Only for media-header templates.

header_media.description:
OR attach the header file (PDF / image / video) directly in ONE multipart/form-data
request — field name `header_media`, up to 16 MB. We host it and use it as the header,
so you don't need a separate upload call. Takes precedence over header_media_url.

header_filename.description:
Display filename the recipient sees for a DOCUMENT header (e.g. "Invoice-2045.pdf").
Optional — when you attach header_media we default it to the uploaded file's own name.

body.description:
BODY variables, positional -> {{1}}, {{2}}, ... Send a list ["John","12345"]
or a 1-indexed map {"1":"John","2":"12345"}. Omit if the body has no variables.

buttons.description: Dynamic button parameters, one object per variable button, e.g. [{"index":0,"sub_type":"url","value":"ORDER123"}].

index.description: Zero-based position of the button in the template.

value.description: The dynamic value — URL suffix or quick-reply payload.

message.const: Template not found in this workspace.

post.description: Sends one approved WhatsApp template to a single recipient with the variable values supplied by your application. Use this endpoint for transactional or campaign messages that must follow a Meta-approved template, including optional header media and button values.

get.description: Deletes a WhatsApp template from the workspace.

put.description: Updates a WhatsApp template and its editable content.

delete.description: Deletes a WhatsApp template from the workspace.

get.description: Lists the outbound webhook endpoints registered for the workspace. Use it to inspect active URLs, subscribed events, enabled status, and the webhook IDs used for updates or deletion.

post.description: Registers an outbound webhook endpoint for the workspace. Wachat sends subscribed message, delivery, contact, device, broadcast, and campaign events to the URL; use a signing secret to verify that deliveries came from Wachat.

delete.description: Removes a registered webhook endpoint and stops future event deliveries to it. Use the webhook ID returned by the list or create operation.

EnrollFlowRequest.description:
Enroll a contact into a flow. Scramble reads these rules to document the
request body. Identify the contact by `contact_id` (a contact already in
the workspace) OR by `phone` (the contact is looked up by its E.164
number). Exactly one is required; the controller resolves it to a Contact
and hands it to FlowEnrollmentService::enroll().

contact_id.description: Id of an existing contact in the workspace. Required unless `phone` is given.

phone.description:
Contact phone in international format (digits, E.164). Used to look up
the contact when `contact_id` is omitted. Required unless `contact_id` is given.

EnrollFlowRequest.title: EnrollFlowRequest

SendMessageRequest.description:
Send a single WhatsApp message. Scramble reads these rules to document the
request body. Supports text, media (by URL), location and Baileys
interactive buttons; template/bulk
sends use the /templates + /broadcasts endpoints.

to.description: Recipient phone in international format (digits, E.164). Required.

device_id.description:
Sending sender (optional — defaults to the workspace's primary).
Accepts a Baileys device id (57), a WABA/Twilio provider-config id
("cfg_20" or a bare 20), or an "engine:id" key — resolved across
both the devices + wa_provider_configs tables. String, not int,
so the "cfg_20" form from /api/v1/devices is accepted.

text.description: Text body (required for text; used as caption for media).

media.description:
Image / video / document / audio sends — EITHER way:
media     — attach the file directly (multipart upload, max 16 MB), OR
media_url — a public URL we download for you.
No need to host the file first; just send `media` in the same call.

buttons.description:
Baileys-only interactive message. The API deliberately exposes
this as a first-class type so Scramble documents it publicly.

SendMessageRequest.title: SendMessageRequest

StoreAutoReplyRequest.description:
Create a keyword auto-reply. Scramble reads these rules to document the
request body. Mirrors the input keys the existing
AutoreplyController::store accepts, exposed under public-facing names. A
"custom" reply carries one or more `replies[]` text variants; a "flow"
reply points at a saved flow_id.

keyword.description: Trigger keyword(s). Comma-separated phrases are allowed. Required.

matching_method.description: How the inbound message is matched against the keyword. Defaults to exact.

fuzzy_similarity.description: Fuzzy match threshold 0-100 (only used when matching_method=fuzzy).

status.description: Whether the rule is active. Defaults to true.

reply_type.description: Reply kind: "custom" (text variants) or "flow" (a saved flow). Defaults to custom.

flow_id.description:
Flow id to run (required when reply_type=flow).
Scope to the caller's workspace so an auto-reply can't reference
another tenant's flow (was a bare `integer` with no ownership).

replies.description: Reply text variants (for reply_type=custom). At least one required for custom.

StoreAutoReplyRequest.title: StoreAutoReplyRequest

StoreBroadcastRequest.description:
Create a broadcast — send one template to a list of contacts and/or a
contact group. Scramble reads these rules to document the request body.

Mirrors the input keys the existing BroadcastsController::store accepts
(broadcast_name / template_id / contacts[] / groups[] / device_id /
schedule_type+send_date+send_time / timezone), exposed under public-facing
names. At least one of `recipients` or `group_id` is required; provide
`schedule_at` to schedule for later, omit it to send now.

name.description: Broadcast label shown in the dashboard. Required.

template_id.description: Approved WaTemplate id to send to every recipient. Required.

group_id.description: Contact-group id — every member is added as a recipient.

device_id.description: Sending device id (optional — defaults to the workspace's primary device).

schedule_at.description: When to send — ISO 8601 / parseable datetime. Omit to send immediately.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for schedule_at (e.g. Asia/Kolkata). Defaults to UTC.

recipients.description: Recipient contact ids. Required unless `group_id` is given.

StoreBroadcastRequest.title: StoreBroadcastRequest

StoreCampaignRequest.description:
Create a campaign — a multi-recipient send (template, custom message or
flow) with optional A/B testing. Scramble reads these rules to document the
request body.

Mirrors the input keys the existing App\CampaignController::store accepts
(campaign_name / device_id / campaign_type / schedule_type / template_id(s) /
flow_id / custom_message / send_date+send_time / timezone / ab_* / contacts),
exposed under public-facing names. Recipients are supplied as a list of
phone numbers in international format.

campaign_name.description: Campaign label shown in the dashboard. Required.

device_id.description: Sending device — the device's phone number or id. Required.

schedule_type.description: When to send: now, later (needs send_date+send_time), or recurring. Required.

template_id.description: WaTemplate id (required for non-A/B template campaigns).

template_id_a.description: A/B testing: the two competing WaTemplate ids.

custom_message.description: Free-text message body (required for custom campaigns).

send_date.description: Date to send on (Y-m-d) — required when schedule_type=later.

send_time.description: Time to send at (HH:MM) — required when schedule_type=later.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for send_date/send_time. Defaults to UTC.

ab_split.description: Percentage of recipients sent variant A (10-90). Defaults to 50.

contacts.description: Recipient phone numbers in international format. At least one required.

StoreCampaignRequest.title: StoreCampaignRequest

StoreContactGroupRequest.description:
Create a contact group in the current workspace. Scramble reads these rules
to document the request body. Mirrors ContactsController::groupStore.

color.description: Optional UI colour (hex or token, e.g. #2563eb).

StoreContactGroupRequest.title: StoreContactGroupRequest

StoreContactRequest.description:
Create a contact in the current workspace. Scramble reads these rules to
document the request body. Mirrors the validation in the existing
ContactsController::store.

name.description: Contact's full display name. Required when first_name is omitted.

first_name.description: Optional name parts. Combined into `name` when `name` is blank.

phone.description: Phone number in international format (digits, E.164). Required.

country_code.description: Country dial code (e.g. +91). Prefixed onto the phone if missing.

note.description: Optional free-text note attached to the contact.

attributes.description: Free-form key/value attributes stored against the contact.

is_unsubscribed.description: Whether the contact has opted out of messages. Defaults to false.

group_ids.description: Group ids the contact belongs to. Each must exist.

items.description:
Scope the existence check to the caller's workspace so a foreign
group id is rejected (was a global `exists` → cross-tenant ref).

StoreContactRequest.title: StoreContactRequest

StoreScheduledRequest.description:
Schedule a WhatsApp send for later. Scramble reads these rules to document
the request body. Mirrors the input keys the existing
QueueController::scheduleMessage accepts (name / message / template_id /
recipients / send_at / timezone / device_id), exposed under public-facing
names. A template OR a message body is required.

message.description: Body text (required unless a template_id is given). Max 4096 chars.

template_id.description: WaTemplate id to send instead of free text (optional).

device_id.description: Sending device id (optional — defaults to the workspace's connected device).

run_at.description: When to send — ISO 8601 / parseable datetime interpreted in `timezone`. Required.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for run_at (e.g. Asia/Kolkata). Defaults to the workspace timezone.

recipients.description: Recipient phone numbers in international format. At least one required.

StoreScheduledRequest.title: StoreScheduledRequest

StoreTemplateRequest.description:
Create a WhatsApp message template. Scramble reads these rules to document
the request body. Mirrors the existing TemplateController::store validation.

category.description: Category — Meta numeric id (1/2/3), meta slug, or industry bucket. Required.

template_body.description: Body text (required for standard templates, max 4096 chars).

language.description: Language code (e.g. en_US). Defaults to en_US.

buttons.description: Buttons — CTA / quick-reply array (or parallel-array form).

latitude.description:
LOCATION header — send a map pin. Provide latitude + longitude
(both required together) with an optional name + address.

StoreTemplateRequest.title: StoreTemplateRequest

StoreWebhookRequest.description:
Register an outbound webhook endpoint for the current workspace. Scramble
reads these rules to document the request body. Mirrors the validation in
the in-app WebhooksController::store.

The platform POSTs a JSON envelope to the registered `url` whenever a
subscribed event fires. When a signing `secret` is configured the request
carries an `X-Wachat-Signature` header (HMAC-SHA256 of the body).

url.description: Public HTTPS endpoint the platform POSTs events to. Required.

name.description: Optional friendly label shown in the dashboard.

secret.description:
Optional HMAC signing secret. When set, deliveries carry an
X-Wachat-Signature header so receivers can verify authenticity.

active.description:
Whether the endpoint is active and should receive events.
Defaults to true.

events.description:
Event names to subscribe to. Omit (or pass ["*"]) to receive all.
Supported events fired by the system:
message_received                 — inbound message received
message_sent                     — outbound message sent
message_delivered                — outbound message delivered
message_read                     — outbound message read
message_failed                   — outbound message failed
broadcast_created                — broadcast created
broadcast_status_updated         — broadcast status changed
broadcast_message_status_updated — per-recipient broadcast status changed
campaign_created                 — campaign created
campaign_status_updated          — campaign status changed
campaign_contact_status_updated  — per-contact campaign status changed
campaign_contact_clicked         — campaign contact clicked a link
campaign_contact_replied         — campaign contact replied
contact_opt_in                   — contact opted in
contact_updated                  — contact updated
device_status_updated            — device (number) status changed
"*"                              — subscribe to every event

StoreWebhookRequest.title: StoreWebhookRequest

UpdateAutoReplyRequest.description:
Update a keyword auto-reply. Scramble reads these rules to document the
request body. Same shape as StoreAutoReplyRequest — the underlying
AutoreplyController::update replaces the rule's settings and appends any new
`replies[]` text variants.

keyword.description: Trigger keyword(s). Comma-separated phrases are allowed. Required.

matching_method.description: How the inbound message is matched against the keyword. Defaults to exact.

fuzzy_similarity.description: Fuzzy match threshold 0-100 (only used when matching_method=fuzzy).

status.description: Whether the rule is active. Defaults to true.

reply_type.description: Reply kind: "custom" (text variants) or "flow" (a saved flow). Defaults to custom.

flow_id.description:
Flow id to run (required when reply_type=flow).
Scope to the caller's workspace so an auto-reply can't reference
another tenant's flow (was a bare `integer` with no ownership).

replies.description: Reply text variants (for reply_type=custom). At least one required for custom.

UpdateAutoReplyRequest.title: UpdateAutoReplyRequest

UpdateContactRequest.description:
Update an existing contact in the current workspace. Every field is
optional — only the keys present in the request body are changed. Scramble
reads these rules to document the request body.

phone.description: Phone number in international format (digits, E.164).

country_code.description: Country dial code (e.g. +91). Prefixed onto the phone if missing.

note.description: Free-text note attached to the contact.

attributes.description: Free-form key/value attributes stored against the contact.

is_unsubscribed.description: Whether the contact has opted out of messages.

group_ids.description: Group ids the contact belongs to (replaces the existing set).

items.description:
Scope the existence check to the caller's workspace so a foreign
group id is rejected (was a global `exists` → cross-tenant ref).

UpdateContactRequest.title: UpdateContactRequest

UpdateTemplateRequest.description:
Update a WhatsApp message template. Scramble reads these rules to document
the request body. Mirrors the existing TemplateController::update validation.

template_type.description: Template type. Defaults to the existing value.

category.description: Category — Meta numeric id (1/2/3), meta slug, or industry bucket. Required.

language.description: Language code (e.g. en_US). Defaults to the existing value.

buttons.description: Buttons — CTA / quick-reply array (or parallel-array form).

latitude.description:
LOCATION header — send a map pin. Provide latitude + longitude
(both required together) with an optional name + address.

UpdateTemplateRequest.title: UpdateTemplateRequest

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
